text:
Aisha - CS: Quick heads-up — we discovered a token-rotation bug that caused partial onboarding failures for a subset of EU trial tenants between ~03:12–03:46 UTC. Some tenants saw repeated 4xx during the OAuth exchange. We're putting together customer comms, a mitigation note, and an RCA timeline.

Marco - CS: Got it. Do we have an authoritative list of affected tenants? need to segment high-touch vs self-serve.

Jamal - Eng Oncall: Mitigation rolled at 03:55 UTC (fallback auth path + replay queue). Replays are running, visible progress for ~70% so far. Quick query I used to pull list: ```SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS errors FROM onboarding_logs WHERE error_code = '401' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-02-10T03:12:00Z' AND '2025-02-10T03:46:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY errors DESC;```

Priya - Solutions Eng: Recommend offering affected customers a 1-week credit + optional 1:1 triage for enterprise/high-touch. I can take top 10 and run through replays tomorrow.

Ken - Support Ops: Drafted a segmented email (high-touch / mid-market / smb) and a scheduled office-hours invite. Draft link: https://redwood.docs/onboard-incident-email-draft — includes apology, timeline, mitigation steps, credit offer, and RCA ETA (48h).

Aisha - CS: Thanks — can one of you paste the final affected-list here so we can tag CS owners? Also want to include a 2-question pulse survey in the message (impact 1-5 + quick free-text).

Marco - CS: I'll review the draft for enterprise tone. Small wording tweak: change "we fixed" -> "we implemented a fix" and add "we will monitor replays for 72h". Approve after that :thumbsup:.

Priya - Solutions Eng: I'll run replays for the top 10 and post a calendar invite for a 1:1 triage block Wed 15:00 UTC. Will also attach short remediation steps customers can run locally.

Ken - Support Ops: Sending plan: 1) immediate targeted note to high-touch (owner follow-up), 2) 2h batched send for mid-market, 3) digest for SMB in 24h. I'll tag records in CRM with incident label.

Jamal - Eng Oncall: Root cause (short): race condition in token refresh path during parallel onboarding writes; patch PR #4821 rolled to prod. RCA doc draft will include timeline, impacted buckets, mitigation steps, and long-term fix; ETA 48h.

Aisha - CS: Ownership summary: Aisha = send coordination & exec notes; Ken = segmented sends & CRM tagging; Priya = triage 1:1s; Jamal = RCA + postmortem. Let's reconvene at 14:00 UTC for final sign-off and confirm the high-touch send list.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-02-10T03:55Z — rollout status: success (v2-auth-fallback) :white_check_mark:

Marco - CS: Also let's capture NPS-ish feedback from the 1:1s and the pulse link so PM can track churn risk. I'll add a short column in the account health dashboard for "incident impact".

Aisha - CS: Great. I'll shepherd the first customer note and post the outbound copy here for sign-off before send. Thanks team. :heart:
